item.content:
About Us

We are a 3-person board game studio based in the historic island town of Visby, Gotland (the very place where we learned to make games). We love collaborating with designers and artists, and above all, we want more people to play and create games. And that’s why we think print-and-play is so great!

Take a 2 min tour around Gotland with us to learn more about our studio and see where we’re heading next!!

The Tour

A Rising Tide Lifts all Boats

We want to support emerging, diverse talent joining the board game industry. Because it’s algebraic: more diverse game crafters lead to more diverse crafted games ;)

The Hidden Power of Format

Print-and-play makes games affordable, instantly accessible to everyone, and uniquely personal. You don’t just play the game, you spend time crafting it, too. And as we all know: "It is the time you spend on your game that makes your game so important." Go, go, PnP!

Nothing New Under the Sun

Board games are great for having fun, but they can also create a safe space to foster integration, emotional regulation and cognitive skills. This gives so much exciting room to explore and create!

The Team

We are alumni of the Game Design Department at Uppsala University, Campus Gotland. Our team:

– Majo 🦙 : From Peru🦙, the only one that knows what she is doing.

– Guido 🧉 : From Argentina🐦, Doesn’t really know how he got here.

– Joel 🦌: From Sweden🫎, always late to meetings, but just to make everyone in the team feel at home.

Follow our Kickstarter to help our studio grow! 🚀

📸 Photo Credits: Photography by Hui Yuan via Instagram

item.title: Our Games.
item.description:
Essom + Hamla

For our first kickstarter we feature two games: Hamla and Essom. Both games were made on Gotland, and they share the award for Best Game Design at the Gotland Game Conference 2025. As the Designers put it: “We are friends that encouraged each other to present our games at the conference, so we see it as a very fitting ending to share the award”.

Essom + Hamla

For our first kickstarter we feature two games: Hamla and Essom. Both games were made on Gotland, and they share the award for Best Game Design at the Gotland Game Conference 2025. As the Designers put it: “We are friends that encouraged each other to present our games at the conference, so we see it as a very fitting ending to share the award”.

Curious about the games?



Essom

Players: 2 | Age: 10+ | Time: 25´

Summary.

Essom is an abstract game design by Guido Salustri, a game designer from Argentina. Essom combines hidden information with tactical depth, where players need to search for and retrieve hidden tokens.

Hamla

Players: 2-6 | Age: 8+ | Time: 15´

Summary.

Hamla is a card game design by Márton Bodrog, a game designer from Hungary. Coming from the world of Trutina, Hamla is a game of cunning, bluffing and a bit of luck, where you take the role of commanders preparing for battle.

Make sure to follow our Kickstarter to keep track of our games!
